title: Value of JOBS_OVERRIDES
description: Per-job overrides keyed by job name, runtime-owned be.* jobs included (be-protocol P14.5). An unknown job name is logged at WARN and ignored.

interval.description: Go duration, for every and singleton jobs.

cron.description: For cron jobs: a five-field cron expression, or @every <Go duration> of at least 1s (P14.6).
